title: Small Dense LDL
subtitle: What small dense LDL measures, how to interpret it, limitations, and when it is clinically useful.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence supports the association of small dense LDL with increased cardiovascular risk and metabolic conditions, with emerging evidence for clinical utility in specific populations. Limitations include heterogeneous testing methods and limited standardized treatment outcomes based on sdLDL levels.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
